title: Alert
overview: In-page status that stays with the content: success, warning, error, info.
apply_when: They need to read recovery or a standing notice on this page, tied to the current goal.
not_when: Sitewide strip (site_alert), floating auto-dismiss (toast), or post-submit field list (error_summary).

vs.why: one full-width site notice at the top
form submit errors linked to fields

role.apply_when: A note they should see with this section.
role.not_when: A sitewide banner (site_alert) or a toast.
A transient toast for a global save.

role.overview: In-page error with the content. Field errors still live on fields.
role.apply_when: A section failed to load, or a page-level problem next to the work.
role.not_when: Only a toast, or field errors with no field association.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Sits with the region it is about.

accessibility.overview: The alert has a name (status word + message).
accessibility.not_when: A colored box with no text.

accessibility.overview: If it appears after load, it is announced.
accessibility.apply_when: A status that was not in the first paint.

accessibility.overview: This is not the only full-width site banner.

keyboard.overview: Links or actions inside are in the tab order. The alert itself is not a trap.
keyboard.apply_when: An alert with a next step.
